summary:
Fhasal is a smart agriculture web platform designed to make farm management simpler and more accessible through technology. It provides users with a centralized place to manage their agricultural fields and access useful farming-related tools.

The platform includes user registration and login, a personalized dashboard, and features to add, view, edit, and delete agricultural fields. Users can explore field details, view geographical boundaries through interactive maps, and manage application notifications. Fhasal also supports seven languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, and Bengali, making it accessible to a wider range of users.

The frontend is developed using React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Axios, Leaflet, and Lucide React. The backend uses Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with Mongoose for database management and JWT and bcryptjs for authentication and password security.

Fhasal aims to use technology to simplify everyday agricultural activities and improve the digital experience of farm management. Future improvements may include weather updates, crop recommendations, soil health information, irrigation management, crop disease detection, and agricultural market prices.

**Fhasal – Grow Smarter. Farm Better.**
details:
Fhasal – Smart Agriculture Platform

1. Project Introduction

Fhasal is a Smart Agriculture Platform developed to make agricultural field management easier, more organized, and accessible through technology. Agriculture plays an important role in society, but managing agricultural fields, maintaining field information, and accessing useful farming resources can be challenging. Fhasal aims to provide a centralized digital platform where users can manage their agricultural fields and access important features through a simple and user-friendly interface.

The platform is designed to improve the digital experience of farm management by bringing different field-related activities together in one application. It provides features such as user authentication, dashboard management, agricultural field management, interactive maps, notifications, and multilingual support.

2. Problem Statement

Managing agricultural field information manually can be time-consuming and difficult. Farmers and field managers may need to maintain information about different fields, their locations, areas, and soil types separately. Accessing and updating this information can become inconvenient when records are not organized in one place.

There is also a need for simple digital platforms that can be accessed by users with different language preferences. Fhasal aims to address these challenges by providing a centralized platform for managing agricultural field information.

3. Project Objectives

The main objectives of Fhasal are:

  • To develop a user-friendly smart agriculture web application.
  • To simplify agricultural field management.
  • To provide a centralized system for storing and accessing field information.
  • To allow users to add, view, update, and delete agricultural fields.
  • To provide interactive maps for visualizing field locations and boundaries.
  • To implement secure user authentication.
  • To provide multilingual support for better accessibility.
  • To create a foundation for future smart agriculture features.

4. Proposed System

The proposed system, Fhasal, is a web-based application that allows users to manage their agricultural field information through an organized digital platform.

Users can register and log in to access the application. After authentication, they can view their dashboard, manage their agricultural fields, explore individual field details, and access notifications. The application uses a frontend and backend architecture, with MongoDB as the database for storing application information.

The platform also provides interactive map functionality and supports seven languages to improve accessibility.

5. Main Modules and Features

5.1 User Authentication Module

This module manages user account access and authentication.

Features include:

  • User registration.
  • User login.
  • Password hashing.
  • JWT-based authentication.
  • Protected application pages.
  • Forgot-password and password-reset functionality.

5.2 Dashboard Module

The dashboard provides an overview of the user's agricultural fields and acts as the main navigation area of the application.

Features include:

  • Overview of registered fields.
  • Access to important application sections.
  • Navigation to field management and other modules.

5.3 Field Management Module

This module allows users to manage agricultural field information.

Features include:

  • Adding new agricultural fields.
  • Viewing registered fields.
  • Editing existing field information.
  • Deleting fields.
  • Maintaining details such as field name, field area, location, and soil type.

5.4 Field Details and Map Module

This module provides detailed information about individual agricultural fields.

Features include:

  • Viewing individual field information.
  • Displaying field geographical locations.
  • Visualizing field boundaries through interactive maps.
  • Using geographical tools for map-related operations.

5.5 Notification Module

The notification module provides a centralized place for viewing and managing application notifications.

Features include:

  • Displaying notifications.
  • Viewing notification details.
  • Managing notification status.
  • Accessing notifications through the application interface.

5.6 Multilingual Module

Fhasal supports seven languages to make the application accessible to users from different linguistic backgrounds.

Supported languages:

  1. English
  2. Hindi
  3. Kannada
  4. Marathi
  5. Telugu
  6. Tamil
  7. Bengali

5.7 Responsive User Interface

The application provides a user-friendly interface designed to work across different screen sizes, including desktops, laptops, and mobile devices.

6. Technologies Used

Frontend Technologies

React.js: Used to develop the interactive user interface and reusable components.

Vite: Used as the frontend development and build tool.

Tailwind CSS: Used for styling the application and creating responsive layouts.

React Router DOM: Used for navigation between different application pages.

Axios: Used to communicate with backend APIs.

Lucide React: Used to provide icons throughout the application.

Leaflet: Used to display interactive maps.

Turf.js: Used for geographical calculations and map-related operations.

Backend Technologies

Node.js: Provides the runtime environment for the backend application.

Express.js: Used to develop backend routes and REST API endpoints.

MongoDB: Used to store application data.

Mongoose: Used for database schemas, models, and database operations.

JWT: Used for token-based user authentication.

bcryptjs: Used to hash user passwords securely.

Development Tools

  • Visual Studio Code
  • Git
  • GitHub
  • MongoDB Atlas
  • Vercel

7. System Architecture

Fhasal follows a frontend-backend architecture consisting of three main layers.

Frontend Layer: Developed using React.js. It provides the user interface, forms, dashboard, field management pages, maps, and notifications.

Backend Layer: Developed using Node.js and Express.js. It handles API requests, authentication, application logic, and communication with the database.

Database Layer: Uses MongoDB with Mongoose to store and retrieve user and agricultural field information.

Application Workflow

  1. The user opens the Fhasal application.
  2. The user registers or logs in.
  3. The frontend sends requests to the backend through Axios.
  4. The backend validates requests and processes application logic.
  5. The backend communicates with MongoDB when data needs to be stored or retrieved.
  6. The backend returns a response to the frontend.
  7. The frontend displays the requested information to the user.

8. Database Description

Fhasal uses MongoDB as its database management system.

The application uses Mongoose to define database models and manage database operations.

The main data categories include:

User Information:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Password hash
  • User role
  • Password-reset information

Agricultural Field Information:

  • Field name
  • Field area
  • Area unit
  • Field location
  • Soil type
  • Geographical boundary information

The database structure supports storing and retrieving information required by the application modules.

9. Security Features

Fhasal includes authentication and security mechanisms to protect user accounts and application data.

These include:

  • Password hashing using bcryptjs.
  • JWT-based authentication.
  • Protected routes for authenticated users.
  • Backend authentication middleware.
  • Environment variables for sensitive configuration.
  • Password-reset token handling.

Sensitive credentials such as database connection strings and secret keys should be stored in environment variables and should not be uploaded to public repositories.

10. Functional Requirements

The application provides the following functional requirements:

  1. Users should be able to register and log in.
  2. Authenticated users should be able to access the dashboard.
  3. Users should be able to add agricultural field information.
  4. Users should be able to view their registered fields.
  5. Users should be able to edit field information.
  6. Users should be able to delete fields.
  7. Users should be able to view individual field details.
  8. Users should be able to access interactive maps.
  9. Users should be able to view and manage notifications.
  10. Users should be able to change the application language.

11. Non-Functional Requirements

  • Usability: The interface should be simple and easy to navigate.
  • Security: User authentication and password protection should be implemented.
  • Performance: The application should respond efficiently to user requests.
  • Maintainability: The code should be organized into reusable components and modules.
  • Scalability: The architecture should support adding more features in the future.
  • Accessibility: Multilingual support should help users with different language preferences.

12. Testing

The application can be evaluated through the following testing activities:

  • Registration and login testing.
  • Authentication and protected-route testing.
  • Field creation testing.
  • Field editing and deletion testing.
  • Field information retrieval testing.
  • Map display testing.
  • Notification interface testing.
  • Language switching testing.
  • Frontend and backend API communication testing.

Testing results should be recorded based on the actual tests performed on the application.

13. Future Scope

Fhasal can be improved further by introducing additional smart agriculture features, including:

  • Weather updates and forecasts.
  • Crop recommendations.
  • Soil health monitoring.
  • Smart irrigation management.
  • Crop disease detection.
  • Agricultural market price information.
  • Crop planning and farming activity tracking.
  • More agriculture-related services and tools.

These features can help develop Fhasal into a more comprehensive smart agriculture platform.

14. Advantages of the Project

  • Provides centralized agricultural field management.
  • Makes field information easier to maintain.
  • Allows users to update field details digitally.
  • Provides geographical visualization through interactive maps.
  • Offers a multilingual user experience.
  • Uses a modern frontend and backend architecture.
  • Provides a foundation for future agriculture-related digital services.

15. Conclusion

Fhasal is a Smart Agriculture Platform developed to simplify agricultural field management through technology. It combines user authentication, dashboard functionality, field management, interactive maps, notifications, and multilingual support in a single web application.

By providing a centralized system for managing agricultural field information, Fhasal aims to make everyday farm management more organized and accessible. The project also provides a foundation for future improvements, such as weather forecasting, crop recommendations, soil health monitoring, irrigation management, and crop disease detection.

Overall, Fhasal represents an effort to bring digital technology into agriculture and create a more convenient experience for managing agricultural information.

Fhasal – Grow Smarter. Farm Better.
